title: Junior/Senior Video Editor
description:
We’re The Branding People , a Malaysia-based digital marketing agency serving brands across Southeast Asia. We turn insights into strategy, strategy into creative work, and creative work into measurable impact .
Our partners are scaling fast, and the demand for high-quality, engaging video content has never been higher. If you’re a Video Editor who can transform raw footage, animations, voiceovers, and creative ideas into scroll-stopping content that drives real results - you’ll fit right in.
What You’ll Be Crafting

• Conceptualize and create engaging short-form videos (10 short form videos per week) for product and promotional campaigns.

• Edit video content for various platforms (e.g.,Facebook & Instagram Ads, TikTok, Instagram Reels) using industry-standard tools.

• Develop storyboards to guide visual direction and ensure a cohesive narrative across all video content.

• Collaborate with media buyers, senior editors, designers, and marketing teams to align content with brand messaging.

• Support pre-production and post-production workflows, including shot planning, rough cuts, and final delivery.

• Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders to refine and improve video output.

• Apply basic knowledge of AI tools to enhance content creation efficiency (bonus).

• Stay updated on video trends, platform algorithms, and best practices in content performance.

Your Superpowers

• Around 1- 3 years of experience in video editing or content creation or a strong portfolio with trending short-form content (e.g., Facebook, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts).

• Proven ability to create engaging and visually appealing video content.

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Capcut; basic knowledge of After Effects is a plus.

• Experience in developing storyboards and basic scripting.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and consistently meet weekly video output KPIs

• Strong understanding of pacing, sound, and visual storytelling.

• Knowledge of motion graphics or animation.

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools for video creation or editing

• Experience with product videos, social ads, or e-commerce visuals.

• Excellent command of both Mandarin and English, including written and verbal communication.

• Awareness of current video trends, platform best practices, and algorithm behavior.

• Open to feedback and willing to learn training and support will be provided for the right creative talent.

What You’ll Get Here

•
Freedom to Work from Anywhere
Remote flexibility that empowers deep work and creative flow.

•
Upskilling That Actually Changes You
Workshops, coaching, and exposure to brands across SEA with real learning and real growth.

•
Lucrative Pay That Reflects Value
Competitive salary packages designed to reward excellence, not just attendance.

•
Health & Wellness Support
Benefits that keep your mind sharp and your energy sustainable.

•
People Who Want You to Win
A driven team that collaborates, questions, builds - and celebrates progress.

•
Plus More - Because We’re Still Growing
We refine, improve, and innovate constantly. You grow as we grow.

title: Financial Controller
description:
We're Hiring: ﻿
Financial Controller
﻿ Fully Remote | EU Company (Cyprus Entity)
Were looking for a hungry, ambitious finance leader ready to help shape the financial future of a fast-growing Group with businesses in advertising Solutions, e-commerce, retail and real estate.
This isn't a traditional corporate CFO role. It's a hands-on, build-from-the-ground-up opportunity where strategy and execution go hand in hand.
As we scale, were looking for someone who wants to own the numbers, influence strategy, and build the financial engine of the business.
If you have 5-7 years of strong finance experience and are ready to step into a leadership seat where your decisions will directly impact growth, while still being comfortable rolling up your sleeves, this could be the opportunity youve been waiting for.
What Youll Be Doing
As CFO, youll work directly with the founders and leadership team to shape the Groups financial strategy and infrastructure.
This is a hands-on finance leadership role, where both strategic thinking and operational execution are essential.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning daily bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping to maintain accurate and reliable accounts

• Managing accounts payable, receivable, and financial reconciliations

• Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts, and budgeting frameworks

• Driving unit economics analysis across clients and revenue streams

• Leading cash flow management and financial planning in a high-growth environment

• Establishing financial processes that scale as the company grows

• Ensuring tax, regulatory, and compliance alignment with our Cyprus-based legal entity

• Acting as a strategic partner to leadership on growth decisions and capital allocation

Youll play a central role in translating operational performance into financial insight and strategy.
What Were Looking For
This role is ideal for someone who is an established CFO or ready to step up into a true CFO position earlier in their career, while still being comfortable owning the financial operations of a growing group.
You likely bring:

• 5-7 years of experience in finance, accounting, FP&A, or corporate finance

• Strong bookkeeping and accounting fundamentals

• Excellent financial modelling and analytical skills

• Exposure to tech, digital advertising, SaaS, or high-growth startups

• Understanding of revenue models, margins, and unit economics

• ACCA/ACA qualified (or equivalent)

• Knowledge on VAT & VIES reporting in the EU

• EU market experience, ideally with multiple companies

• The ability to operate in a fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environment

• A mindset that combines ownership, precision, and strategic thinking

• Experience with scaling finance functions is a strong advantage.

• Advance experience working with Xero (software).

Why This Role Works Remotely
We operate as a remote-first team, working with talent across multiple countries while our legal entity and corporate structure are based in Cyprus.
This allows you to:

• Work fully remotely while contributing to a global business

• Operate within a stable EU framework

• Collaborate with an international team in a fast-moving industry

We care far more about capability, ownership, and impact than where you sit.
Why This Role Is Different
Many finance roles support growth.
This one helps design it.
You wont just inherit systems-youll build them.
You wont just report numbers-youll own them end-to-end.
For the right candidate, this is a chance to grow into the role of CFO while helping build a company at the same time.
Interested?
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could do your best work, apply now.
Were excited to meet finance leaders who are ready to step up, take ownership, and grow with us.

title: Manager of Strategic Customer Success

As our Manager of Strategic Customer Success, you’ll:

- Up Market Motion: You have worked with enterprise customers and scaled their use case as they grow in complexity.

- Operational Mindset: You’ve helped implement and improve team processes, and you bring a structured lens to scaling what works while staying adaptable.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: You’re comfortable partnering with teams like Sales, Product, and Support to align around customer needs and elevate the experience.

- Problem-Solving Orientation: You don’t rely on “what worked before” - you’re thoughtful, pragmatic, and eager to find solutions that fit the unique needs of your team and customers.

- Data-Driven: You are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decision-making, continually improving both the team and customer experience.

- Customer-First Thinking: You have a deep understanding of B2B customer needs and have a history of ensuring outstanding support experiences.

- Lifecycle Awareness: You understand the full customer lifecycle, and know how to effectively partner with cross-functional teams to ensure strong handoffs and sustained success.

YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Law360, a LexisNexis company, is an online newswire for business lawyers that covers major litigation, transactions, and regulatory issues. Founded in 2004 and acquired by LexisNexis in 2012, Law360 is a cutting-edge organization and one of the fastest-growing subscription news services in the U.S. Our subscribers include the largest law firms in the U.S. and around the world, in-house counsel at major corporations, and key decision-makers in the government sector.
Are you excited to break news on the technologies transforming the legal industry?
Do you enjoy uncovering stories, identifying emerging trends, and delivering insightful journalism on artificial intelligence and legal innovation?
About our Team
Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.
About the Role
This role can be performed in San Francisco or Los Angeles.
Law360 is seeking a senior reporter to cover the legal industry in California and the wider adoption of legal technology and artificial intelligence across law firms, courts and regulators.
We are looking for an ambitious journalist who thrives on breaking news, spotting emerging trends, and delivering insightful coverage that explains how the technology is reshaping the business and practice of law. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable filing quick-turn stories on major developments in the legal industry and producing deeply reported features and enterprise pieces that put those developments into context.
This reporter will cover one of the most consequential shifts facing the legal industry: the rise of generative AI and the broader transformation of legal services through technology. They should be curious about how AI tools are being adopted, how the technology works, the successes and failures, and what these changes mean for lawyers, clients, courts, regulators, and the economics of the legal profession.
The reporter is expected to cultivate a network of sources across the legal tech ecosystem, including law firm leaders, startup founders, investors, consultants, academics, and regulators. Candidates should have strong news judgment, a proven ability to generate scoops, familiarity with technology and the confidence to chase exclusive reporting in a competitive environment.
The successful candidate will also be able to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling journalism for a sophisticated legal audience. They should have strong writing skills and a demonstrated ability to move seamlessly between breaking news, analysis, and longer-form feature stories.

Preferences

title: S&OP Planning Analyst
tags: Programs : Demand & Supply Planning : Demand & Supply Planning
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.

• Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.

• Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.

• Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

• Report on and analyze supply and material health to inform key decisions for Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Business Development.

• Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

• Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)

• 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.

• Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.

• Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s degree or other higher education.

• Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.

• Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.

• Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.

We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!
We are looking for an outstanding Senior Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!
What you'll be doing:

• Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

• Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

• Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

• Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

• Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

• Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

• Engage efficiently with upstream communities - including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects - to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

• 8+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

• Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

• Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

• Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

• Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

• Proficiency in Golang/Python

• Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

• Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

• Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

• Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

• PhD in relevant areas

title: Kubernetes Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Overview:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Kubernetes administrator with strong experience in managing and deploying cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP). The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining, scaling, and optimizing Kubernetes clusters in a multi-cloud environment, ensuring high availability, security, and performance. This role requires hands-on expertise in containerization, cloud services, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) practices.
The Kubernetes Administrator will collaborate closely with development, support, and cloud operations teams to support cloud-native applications and infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:

• Kubernetes Management:

• Deploy, configure, and manage Kubernetes clusters on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.

• Implement and manage automated scaling, health checks, and logging for Kubernetes environments.

• Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for Kubernetes clusters in multi-cloud environments.

• Cloud Infrastructure Management:

• Work with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to design and manage cloud-native infrastructures.

• Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, cost, and resource efficiency.

• Collaborate with development teams to manage deployments to Kubernetes clusters.

• Configure application and network integrations to customer on-premises and cloud-based services.

• Security & Compliance:

• Implement Kubernetes security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and encryption.

• Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements within the cloud environment.

• Manage and monitor IAM roles, policies, and permissions on Azure, AWS, GKE platforms.

• Documentation & Reporting:

• Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of Kubernetes configurations, best practices, and cloud infrastructure.

• Provide regular reports on cluster performance, issues, and resolutions to stakeholders.

• Collaboration & Support:

• Work with development teams to ensure seamless deployment and operation of applications within the Kubernetes clusters.

• Troubleshoot and resolve Kubernetes-related issues across multiple environments.

• Provide on-call support as required for cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience:

• Proven experience (4+ years) as a Kubernetes Administrator, Cloud Engineer, or similar role with hands-on experience in managing production Kubernetes cluster environments.

• Strong knowledge of container orchestration and management in Kubernetes.

• In-depth experience with cloud-native services on Azure (AKS, Virtual Networks), AWS (EKS, EC2, S3), and GCP (GKE, Cloud Storage) .

• Skills & Expertise:

• Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Helm, ArgoCD).

• Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Opensearch).

• Strong knowledge of cloud security best practices, including network security, identity, and access management (IAM).

Key Competencies:

• Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex systems in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across teams, including developers, cloud engineers, and support.

• Adaptability: Comfort with rapidly changing technologies and cloud service offerings.

• Attention to Detail: Ability to manage and maintain configurations with accuracy and precision.

• Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills to document processes, report issues, and explain solutions.

title: Data API Engineer
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data API Engineer to join our Data API Team and help improve the feature set, reliability and performance of our Data API, based on the PostgREST project.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Work on PostgREST’s PostgreSQL driver (based on Hasql) and remove bottlenecks and improve it’s performance.

- Work on PostgREST development of new features and bug fixes, aligned towards the goal of a multitenant Data API.

- Resolve incidents and escalated support issues, while also improving observability and performance.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to debug and solve integration issues with the Supabase platform.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Strong Haskell skills with at least 3 years of experience.

- Experience using the C language.

- Solid knowledge of SQL and plpgsql scripting in PostgreSQL.

- Strong track record of contributing to and engaging with open-source projects. Bonus points if you’ve maintained an open source project.

- Strong experience with providing technical support to users with varying levels of technical expertise.

- Experience with debugging applications under the Linux operating system.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support-not replace-existing tools and communities.

About Thunkable
Thunkable is the leading no-code and AI platform that empowers anyone to design, develop, and deploy powerful, native mobile applications without writing a single line of code. Our mission is to make app development accessible to everyone-transforming passive consumers into active creators of technology.
Founded in 2016 by Arun Saigal and Weihua Li, former members of the MIT App Inventor and MIT Scratch team, Thunkable now supports millions of users across 184 countries, including a quarter of Fortune 500 companies. We’re backed by Lightspeed, NEA, Owl Ventures, SV Angel, and Y Combinator.
Role Overview
The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the front end of the sales pipeline. They turn target accounts and inbound interest into qualified, sales-ready meetings for Account Executives. The role blends outbound prospecting, inbound lead follow-up, and early-stage discovery, and success is measured almost entirely by pipeline created.
In one line: Find the right people, start the right conversations, qualify fit honestly, and hand AEs opportunities worth their time.
Key Responsibilities

• Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop Target Accounts and inbound leads to create sales-ready meetings and opportunities. This includes target market penetration, calling on CXOs, senior-level executives, trade show attendance, following up on marketing-generated leads, webinar and event follow-up, creative campaign and door opener outreach, and more

• Interact with prospects via telephone, video correspondence, and email

• Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to stimulate opportunity

• Disseminate opportunities to appropriate AE, educating each rep as necessary about the opportunity

• Lead the discovery process by identifying the prospect’s pain points, while effectively setting the stage for the sales process

• Effectively handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence

• Become a trusted resource and develop productive relationships with prospects

• Update lead scoring and prospect interaction in CRM to ensure efficient lead management

• Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline targets

• Provide closed-loop feedback to ensure continuous process optimization

• Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet our core values

Required Qualifications

• 1+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales, business development, or customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or tech

• High level of organization and attention to detail - You can read between the lines to identify the customer’s need while effectively taking & sharing notes. Then following up as needed with both internal and external stakeholders

• Pre-call planning & research - Efficiently finding the needle in a haystack, such as the right decision maker or key tidbits of information that will inspire action from prospects

• Opportunity qualification and objection handling - We want you to communicate like an empathetic human being. And determine if our platform is a right fit for the customers’ needs, then communicate it appropriately

• Call and email structure and control - You’ll own the outreach of our company to potential customers. You will have free reign to tweak, tune, and craft content to ensure it hits the right target. You can communicate via phone and email effectively, and if changes are needed, you are driven to try new things

• Effective time management - Stay on top of client conversations, while balancing new opportunities. You should be able to answer: everyone is important, but who gets prioritized?

• Ability to handle relationships at all levels of an organization - Any foot in the door is a step forward. Can you communicate to start-up founders, developers, product managers, VPs, and C-level executives?

• Consistent track record of achieving measurable sales goals in a fast-paced environment - This is a results-driven job.

title: AI Tutor - Oromo
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Oromo. Your expertise will directly shape how Grok speaks and understands Oromo, from pronunciation and natural phrasing to cultural nuance. You will see your work show up in a product used by people around the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Annotate, label, and provide feedback on multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, and speech samples using proprietary tools.

• Translate and localize text (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other content) from English into Oromo, with attention to accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural fit.

• Help produce clear, natural audio data that accurately captures linguistic and prosodic details such as intonation, rhythm, and accent.

• Collaborate with technical staff to refine annotation guidelines and tools for handling accents, background noise, speech variation, and multilingual audio.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Proficiency in Oromo at CEFR C1 level or higher.

• English proficiency at CEFR B2 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Native proficiency in Oromo.

• English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.

• Experience in one or more of the following areas: 

• Advanced transcription or audio annotation, with strong attention to accents, prosody, disfluencies, and variable recording quality.

• Translation or localization work (especially UI, product copy, or conversational text) between English and Oromo.

• Voice recording, voice acting, podcasting, or related audio production that demonstrates clear delivery and attention to sound quality.

• Background in linguistics, phonetics, speech sciences, or hands-on work with speech/audio datasets and AI training data.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

• This is a remote role which may be performed from the following countries:

• United States

• United Kingdom

• Canada

• Australia

• This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position, depending on role / business needs and candidate availability. Full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.

• Positions are typically offered as fixed-term employment contracts of 6 months. Extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs.

• For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.

• We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

• Travel to a SpaceXSI site may be required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our  Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

The Opportunity

Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.

Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.

We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. You will work with a dedicated designer, an engineering manager, and a dedicated engineering team.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right

• Own users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it

• Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors

• Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired

Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself

• Own the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI

• Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does

Agents and natural language: let admins state intent

• Define how agents fit into access management. An admin should be able to say what they want and have the system propose the configuration that satisfies it

title: Avvocato/a civilista, consulenza legale
description:
Milano, ibrido | Partita IVA | 12 mesi rinnovabili

Chi siamo

Enpal è leader europeo nel fotovoltaico residenziale e lavora per rendere l'energia pulita accessibile a tutte le famiglie. In Italia siamo cresciuti molto e continuiamo a crescere: ci stiamo strutturando e conquistiamo sempre più spazio nel mercato del fotovoltaico.

Per accompagnare questa fase cerchiamo un avvocato o un'avvocata civilista che ci affianchi con continuità su tutte le questioni di diritto civile dell'azienda.

Il ruolo

È una collaborazione libero professionale in Partita IVA, continuativa e con impegno prevalente. Ti chiediamo una disponibilità ampia e costante, per diventare il punto di riferimento legale delle persone che guidano l'azienda.

Ti confronterai direttamente con l'Amministratore Delegato e con i responsabili delle diverse divisioni.

Di cosa ti occuperai

- Precontenzioso: reclami, diffide, contestazioni su garanzie e vizi, gestione delle controversie prima che arrivino in tribunale

- Contenzioso: oggi le cause sono seguite da studi esterni. Potrai coordinarti con loro e, in prospettiva, seguire direttamente alcuni contenziosi

- Recupero crediti: solleciti, messe in mora, strategie di recupero

- Contratti con i clienti: redazione, revisione e aggiornamento dei contratti di vendita e installazione, con attenzione alla tutela del consumatore (Codice del Consumo)

- Contratti con fornitori e installatori: forniture, appalti e subappalti, accordi quadro, livelli di servizio

- Contratti commerciali: agenzia e procacciamento d'affari, NDA, locazioni e altre tipologie che serviranno al business

- Consulenza quotidiana: pareri rapidi e pratici sulle questioni civilistiche che emergono nelle varie aree aziendali

Il diritto del lavoro resta fuori dal perimetro del ruolo.

Cosa cerchiamo

- Iscrizione all'Albo degli Avvocati

- Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in diritto civile, con una buona pratica nella contrattualistica

- Inglese almeno di livello B2 (alcuni documenti e interlocutori del gruppo sono internazionali)

- Approccio pratico e orientato alla soluzione: ti chiediamo di aiutarci a decidere, non solo di dirci cosa non si può fare

- Capacità di spiegare questioni legali in modo chiaro anche a chi non è del settore

- Autonomia nell'organizzare il lavoro e nel gestire le priorità

Cosa offriamo

- Collaborazione in Partita IVA con contratto di 12 mesi, rinnovabile

- Compenso da concordare in base all'esperienza e alla disponibilità, con la possibilità di un fisso mensile

- Sede a Milano in zona Repubblica

- Un ruolo centrale in un'azienda in crescita, con un rapporto diretto con il top management

- Un settore con un impatto concreto sulla transizione energetica

title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, AI-Native IT Service Management
description:
About the team
Service Operations is where enterprises find out whether their technology actually works. An outage starts, someone gets paged, a bridge call spins up, and the first twenty minutes go to working out what broke rather than fixing it.
Our team owns the products that close that gap: incident and major incident, problem and root cause, change, on-call, and Notify. The people using them go well beyond the service desk, from application, platform, infrastructure, and network teams to DevOps and SRE groups who get alerted around the clock and the major incident commanders pulling everyone onto one call. Thousands of the largest IT organizations run their operations on these products. We are rebuilding them AI-native, not AI-assisted, with agents that triage, correlate, and resolve, and with people moving from doing the work to directing it. Our goal is Zero Service Outage.
About the role
You will own a piece of that portfolio outright: what good looks like for it, who it is for, and whether we are honestly there yet. Zero Service Outage is the goal, and the work is making it true for the customers who run their operations on these products every day.
The interesting part of this job is not the model. It is the environment it runs in. Service operations data is the messiest data in the enterprise: half-populated CMDBs, incident descriptions written in a hurry at 2am, alert noise from a dozen monitoring tools, and naming conventions that differ by region. An agent that triages perfectly against a clean eval set can behave very differently against a real customer’s incident stream, for reasons that have nothing to do with reasoning ability. Understanding why, and designing for it, is the job.
We also carry an installed base. Customers run today’s experience in production, and moving them onto an AI-native one is not a UI refresh. It is a change to how their IT team works, who approves what, and what an operator trusts an agent to do unsupervised. You will be making calls about what we carry forward, what we leave behind, and what we have to earn the right to automate.
How we work is changing as fast as what we build. Prototype instead of describing the idea. Put a working demo in front of people instead of a slide about a demo. Draft the spec, stand up a rough eval harness, pull your own data. ServiceNow invests in state-of-the-art tooling and expects you to use it. Product managers are better positioned than anyone to lead that shift, and part of this role is pulling the team around you into it.
What you get to do in this role

• Own an AI-native ITSM product end to end, from the customer problem through launch criteria to how it performs in production.

• Set product strategy for the Service Operations portfolio that supports ServiceNow ’s growth toward $10B+ in revenue.

• Build, not just specify. Prototype the interaction, stand up the eval harness, and get into the agent execution logs to understand what happened on the runs that failed.

• Define what good means for an autonomous agent in an operational context where the cost of a wrong action is a second outage. Hold the line on it with engineering and have the honest conversation about what we can defensibly promise.

• Work with design partners across the teams that run on this: service desk, application and infrastructure support, DevOps and SRE, and major incident command. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Learning Sandbox

We create learning experiences that engage, empower and inspire. Learning Sandbox is a global learning consultancy bringing together learning, creativity and technology to help organisations solve meaningful learning challenges.
Our work spans digital learning, education, science, technology and everything in between. We work with ambitious organisations and multidisciplinary teams to turn complex ideas into experiences that are clear, engaging and impactful.
We’re a curious, collaborative team that cares about putting people first, growing together and doing exceptional work that enriches the world.
About our client: LabXchange
LabXchange is a nonprofit education project based at Harvard University. Too many students, whether because of economic or geographic limitations, lack access to high-quality science education and the chance to engage meaningfully in the scientific process. Globally, this has led to significant gaps in diversity across scientific fields and in scientific literacy overall. LabXchange believes students everywhere should have an equal opportunity to prepare for and succeed in science.
To make that real, LabXchange offers the best of digital science education to teachers and students around the world, for free, through an advanced, flexible and interactive learning platform. It goes well beyond text, video and multiple-choice questions, with virtual lab simulations, interactive animations, experimental design simulations and a knowledge graph that can be remixed into customised learning pathways. Social features like private classes, discussion forums and mentorship connect learners with educators.
About the role
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own growth for the LabXchange platform: more learners and educators finding it, and more of them coming back. You'll set the growth strategy, turn data into a clear roadmap, and work with engineering, design, content and marketing to ship experiments that move acquisition, activation and engagement. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dashboard as in a roadmap review.
What you’ll be doing

• Own the growth strategy for LabXchange across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention, and turn it into a prioritised roadmap. This will include the USA and a global strategy.

• Grow the user base by finding and scaling the channels that bring in students, educators and institutions, including organic search, marketing, partnerships and referral loops.

• Increase engagement by improving onboarding, discovery and the paths that bring learners and educators back week after week.

• Lead with data. Define the growth metrics, build and maintain dashboards, run funnel and cohort analysis, and use the findings to decide what to build next.

• Run a steady experimentation programme: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, size impact and share what you learn.

• Drive SEO and content discoverability with content and engineering teams, so our simulations, lessons and pathways reach people searching for them.

• Manage the core library experience: how learners and educators find, browse and reach the right content, and how the library is organised so that it happens quickly. Manage the development and redesign of the LabXchange platform.

• Work across teams with engineering, design, content, marketing and partners, and keep stakeholders and funders informed on progress and results.

• Manage stakeholders and projects across multiple capabilities (engineering, design, content, marketing and partners), keeping priorities, timelines, dependencies and expectations aligned from kickoff through delivery.

• Keep stakeholders in the loop. Announce releases in various Slack channels and facilitate catchups with various stakeholders.

• Bring in the user's voice through interviews, surveys and usability testing with students and educators around the world.

• Manage a multi-timezone team to achieve LabXchange’s growth goa

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

The Network Engineering Manager (AI HPC) leads our US network engineering team: around 10-20 engineers who design, build and run the high-performance networks behind our AI data centers. You will be accountable for what the team delivers across our US sites and for how the team grows. That means hiring well, developing every engineer, and building the standards and habits that let us bring new GPU capacity online quickly and reliably.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You need to hold your own in a fabric design review or a difficult troubleshooting call, but you will be measured mainly by the strength of the team you build and the engineers you develop. Responsibilities
Leading and developing the team

• Lead, coach and develop a team of around 12 network engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give honest, timely feedback.

• Own hiring for the US team: work with leadership on headcount and the right mix of levels, run structured interviews and technical assessments, and close strong candidates.

• Build a learning culture through design reviews, peer review of configurations and code, blameless post-incident reviews, internal knowledge sharing, and support for vendor training and certification.

• Plan team capacity across concurrent builds and operational work. Balance workload, travel and on-call so the pace is sustainable, and cross-train so no site or skill depends on one person.

Delivering the network

• Own network delivery for our US AI data center builds, from design and bill of materials through installation, cabling, configuration, validation and handover, against agreed capacity dates.

• Work with technical program managers, construction, electrical, data center operations and vendors on schedules, rack layouts, cabling plans and readiness. Raise risks early, with options.

• Set and hold standards for change control, documentation, acceptance testing and handover to operations.

• Report on delivery and team health, for example build progress against plan, acceptance test results, incident trends, automation coverage, hiring and retention.

Requirements

• 10+ years in network engineering, including at least 3 years directly managing engineers (hiring, performance reviews and career development).

• A track record of developing engineers: people you have hired, coached and promoted, and teams that learned to deliver without you in the detail.

• Experience growing a technical team through hiring: defining roles, running structured interviews and technical assessments, and onboarding new starters.

• Deep hands-on background in large-scale data center networks, including Layer 2/3 (VLANs, VXLAN, BGP EVPN, OSPF, IS-IS) and Clos/ECMP fabric design, enough to review designs and coach senior engineers.

• Experience delivering network builds for new data centers or major expansions against fixed dates, working with construction, electrical and operations teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical risk and trade-offs to non-network stakeholders and senior leaders.

• Strong ownership mindset and a great attitude.

• Based in the US, able to travel regularly t

Regulatory & Privacy Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO), part of OpenAI’s broader User Operations organization. We build and run the operational programs that protect user rights and support OpenAI’s legal, regulatory & privacy obligations across its products and developer tools.

We partner with Legal, Privacy Engineering, Product, Policy, Governance, Risk & Compliance, Support Operations, and external vendors to resolve sensitive cases and build reliable, scalable operations. Our remit spans privacy, online safety, AI regulation, and intellectual property.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Operations Analyst to own and evolve our global Privacy Operations workstream from Dublin. This individual contributor role combines hands-on management of complex privacy matters with accountability for operational health, vendor quality, and program improvement.

You will take end-to-end ownership of how privacy rights requests are received, assessed, routed, and resolved across a tiered operating model. You will partner closely with Privacy Legal, the Data Protection Officer’s office, Privacy Engineering, and operations teams to translate legal guidance into practical workflows and resolve issues that cross organizational boundaries.

Beyond keeping operations healthy, you will set priorities and deliver improvements that reduce avoidable demand, strengthen controls, and enable safe automation. - Independently investigate and resolve complex or sensitive privacy cases, including third-party requests, account restrictions, and complaints about personal information in AI outputs. Recognize when legal interpretation or technical investigation is needed and coordinate the right partners through resolution.

- Own operational health across internal and vendor-supported queues. Use demand forecasts, backlog age, response and resolution times, quality, and capacity data to identify emerging risks and act before deadlines or user outcomes deteriorate.

- Drive vendor performance through clear procedures, training, quality calibration, escalation criteria, and corrective actions. Expand delegated handling where appropriate, with the controls and evidence needed to maintain quality.

- Build and deliver a prioritized roadmap for workflow simplification, self-service, tooling, and AI-assisted automation. Define requirements, evaluate accuracy and failure modes, establish human review and escalation safeguards, and measure impact after launch.

- Translate privacy requirements and Legal guidance into standard operating procedures, decision trees, case documentation, and operational controls. Keep guidance current as products, policies, and requirements evolve.

- Lead Privacy Operations readiness for product launches and policy changes. Assess likely demand, new case types, routing, capacity, and dependencies, and drive practical mitigations with cross-functional owners.

- Investigate handling failures and recurring complaints, establish root causes and wider exposure, and deliver corrective actions with clear ownership and evidence of effectiveness.

title: IT Solutions Architect (Specialty Microsoft Cloud)

The role designs and maintains the technical standard for VC3 ’s Microsoft offerings, maintains the Microsoft 365 licensing and adoption paths we take clients along, and supports VC3 ’s Microsoft partnership. It also leads R&D, builds VC3 technical standards, and does hands-on work in VC3 ’s own Azure and Microsoft 365 environment. Assist with Product design, pricing, and partnership decisions. 

This role is ideal for an experienced professional with deep knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and MSP toolsets. This position requires knowledge transfer to both technical and non-technical staff through excellent communication and comprehensive documentation. The role is primarily remote but may require occasional travel within our operational territory. 

What you will be doing:

Azure offerings 

• Design and maintain the reference architecture and standard build for VC3 ’s Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop offering, including published apps and full desktops. 

• Apply product design practices to the VC3 Azure offerings: gather requirements from Sales, Service, and clients, define service tiers and features, and write service descriptions. 

• Build a security baseline into the standard, including identity, Conditional Access, endpoint protection, and data protection controls. 

• Contribute technical input and Azure cost estimates for Azure offerings 

• Build runbooks, training, and documentation for handoff to Project and Service teams. 

• Support pilot and early-adopter deployments, gather feedback, and refine the offering based on lessons learned. 

Microsoft 365 pathing 

• Design end-to-end solutions using Microsoft 365 technologies, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and Purview, and integrate them with Azure, AVD, and VC3 ’s other service offerings to meet client and internal business needs. 

• Maintain standard Microsoft 365 licensing and adoption paths for clients, including security, compliance, and Copilot readiness. 

• Map security and compliance capabilities in each path to client needs and regulatory requirements. 

• Empower VC3 Quoting teams to answer technical licensing questions 

• Track Microsoft licensing and product changes and recommend updates to the paths.

Microsoft partnership support 

• Coordinate with other leaders to ensure our Microsoft partnership is in good standing  

• Administer Partner Center, including GDAP relationships and delegated access to client tenants, following least-privilege access practices. 

• Work in coordination with VC3 procurement teams to identify Microsoft incentive and funding programs that could support VC3 offerings. 

Architecture, standards, and R&D

About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.
